answer: Recursive assay: each agent action must cite a prior state hash multiplied into a keccak of the agent's copper-keyed TPM quote. The contract checks the cited hash nests a basalt-mineral grain: a 2^21-step memory-hard VDF whose seed is the prior agent's output. Producing action N requires replaying all N VDF chains. Attack: faking k sybils needs k×2^21 sequential steps, since parallelism only helps per chain. A pearl (turnkey hash) buys nothing. Cost: linear time × k, not hardware.
